publisherGuidelines.metaDescription: What can be published on Globanic, the review process, and publisher responsibilities.
publisherGuidelines.intro: This guide explains what can be published on Globanic, how it gets reviewed, and each publisher's responsibilities. To start publishing, see the
publisherGuidelines.section1Body: Globanic currently supports five types of academic resources: courses, dissertations, articles, theses, and books. A resource must be genuine academic content linked — as far as possible — to a university, specialty, or clear academic domain.
publisherGuidelines.section2Body: The information attached to every resource (title, description, keywords, year, language, university, and specialty) must be accurate and reflect the file's actual content. Misleading information may lead to the resource being rejected or later removed.
publisherGuidelines.section3BodyPrefix: You must own the resource you upload, or hold the authorization required to publish it. Uploading others' work without permission is not allowed. See the
publisherGuidelines.section4Body: Content should preferably be well-organized, complete, and readable. Corrupted files, incomplete files, or files copied verbatim without adding value may be rejected during review.
publisherGuidelines.section5Item1: Content that infringes another party's intellectual property rights.
publisherGuidelines.section5Item2: Non-academic or irrelevant content (advertising, promotional content, spam).
publisherGuidelines.section5Item4: Descriptive information that is inaccurate or deliberately misleading.
publisherGuidelines.section6Body: Every resource goes through the following statuses: draft, then submitted for review, then under review, then one of three outcomes — accepted (and published), rejected, or changes requested. No resource is shown publicly before it is officially published.
publisherGuidelines.section7Body: When a resource is rejected or changes are requested, the publisher is given feedback explaining the reason wherever possible, so they can fix the issue and resubmit if that is possible.
publisherGuidelines.section8Body: The publisher remains responsible for every resource they publish even after it is published, including responding to any reports related to it and keeping its attached information accurate.
publisherGuidelines.section9Body: Every publisher receives their own permanent referral link. Using this link in misleading ways (such as impersonation or false promotion) is prohibited, as it may result in the publisher's account being suspended.
publisherGuidelines.section10Body: Violating any of the points above may result in the resource being rejected, removed after publication, or the publisher status being suspended, depending on the nature and frequency of the violation.

legalPrivacy.metaDescription: How Globanic collects and uses data.
legalPrivacy.intro: This page describes the actual current practices for collecting and using data on Globanic, without any claims that do not match what is actually implemented.
legalPrivacy.section1Body: We only collect the information necessary to operate the platform, which includes the following categories:
legalPrivacy.section2Body: When creating an account: email and password (stored encrypted, never stored as plain text), and full name. When applying as a publisher: academic status, university and specialty (if specified), an academic email, and a proof document for administrative review.
legalPrivacy.section3Body: We log view and download events for each resource (session identifier, a hashed fingerprint of the IP address rather than the address itself, country, device type, and traffic source) for statistics and abuse-prevention purposes, as well as saved resources and followed authors.
legalPrivacy.section4Body: We use a cookie for the login session (Auth.js), and a separate cookie for an anonymous analytics session identifier (containing no personal information) used to prevent counting duplicate views.
legalPrivacy.section5Body: When you arrive via a publisher's referral link, we record the attribution of that visit to that publisher for a limited period (renewable on a later visit via the same link), linked either to an anonymous session identifier or to your account once signed in. This data is purely descriptive of the traffic source and is not used to calculate earnings or revenue ownership in any way.
legalPrivacy.section6Body: The analytics used are entirely internal (our own database), and we do not currently use any third-party analytics or advertising tools.
legalPrivacy.section7Body: Publisher profile information (university, specialty, academic email) is used for verification purposes and for the limited public display associated with their page on the platform.
legalPrivacy.section8Body: When you add an account to receive earnings (such as CCP/Baridi Mob), the sensitive data (account number and key) is fully encrypted when stored. This encrypted data can only be accessed through a very restricted administrative permission, and every such access is recorded in an internal audit log.
legalPrivacy.section9Body: We apply reasonable technical measures to protect data, including encrypting passwords and sensitive payment data, and enforcing permissions at the level of each individual sensitive operation.
legalPrivacy.section10Body: We retain account data for as long as the account remains active. View/download logs and audit logs are retained for review, transparency, and financial purposes related to publisher earnings.
legalPrivacy.section11Body: We do not sell your personal data. Account or activity data is not shared with third parties beyond what is necessary to operate the platform (such as a cloud file storage provider).
legalPrivacy.section12BodyPrefix: You can view and edit your account information from within it. For account deletion requests or additional questions about your data, see the
legalPrivacy.section13BodyPrefix: For any inquiry about this policy, see the
legalPrivacy.section14Body: This policy may be updated as the platform and actual data-collection practices evolve.

legalCopyright.metaDescription: Copyright policy and how to report a potential infringement on Globanic.
legalCopyright.intro: We take intellectual property rights seriously. This page explains the responsibilities of each party and how to report a potential infringement.
legalCopyright.section1Body: The rights to each resource published on the platform remain with its original owner. Publishing a resource on Globanic does not transfer its intellectual property to the platform.
legalCopyright.section2BodyPrefix: Every publisher bears full responsibility for ensuring they hold the rights, or have obtained the necessary permission, to publish any resource they upload. See the
legalCopyright.section3BodyPrefix: The current practical way to report a specific resource is the
legalCopyright.section3BodyMiddle: button found on the page of every published resource, with the reason
legalCopyright.section3BodySuffix: . This report reaches the administrative review team directly for their consideration.
legalCopyright.section4Heading: 4. Information Required for a Valid Report
legalCopyright.section4Intro: When submitting a report, your description should ideally include:
legalCopyright.section4Item1: The precise link to the resource in question.
legalCopyright.section4Item2: A clear description of the original work whose rights you claim were infringed.
legalCopyright.section4Item3: Proof of your status as the rights holder or their legal representative, if possible.
legalCopyright.section4Item4: Any additional information that helps with reviewing the report.
legalCopyright.section5BodyPrefix: If you are a publisher and your resource received a report you believe is unfounded, you can clarify your position via the
legalCopyright.section5BodySuffix: . There is currently no separate formal appeal mechanism within the platform; each case is manually reviewed by the administration team.
legalCopyright.section6Body: Accounts that repeatedly receive documented reports of intellectual property infringement may be subject to additional measures, up to and including suspension of publisher status, at the administration team's discretion for each case.
legalCopyright.section7Body: Globanic does not currently announce the designation of a formal registered agent under any specific copyright procedure in any particular country. Reports are currently handled through the internal review mechanism described above, and this page may be updated should the platform adopt an additional formal process later.
legalCopyright.section8BodyPrefix: For any inquiry not related to a specific resource, see the

trust.metaDescription: How Globanic handles content review, integrity, and analytics.
trust.intro: This page explains, realistically and without exaggeration, how Globanic handles academic content, its review, and protecting the platform's integrity.
trust.section1BodyPrefix: No resource appears to the public before it is reviewed. Every resource a publisher uploads goes through a path: draft, then submitted for review, then under review, then it is either approved and published, rejected, or changes are requested. Full details are in the
trust.section2Body: Every publisher is responsible for holding the rights or authorization required to publish what they upload, and for the accuracy of the information associated with their resources. Globanic does not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of every published resource, but it does apply a review process before publication and responds to reports afterward.
trust.section3BodyPrefix: Every resource page contains a direct reporting tool (copyright infringement, incorrect information, a broken file, or inappropriate content) that reaches the review team directly. See the
trust.section3BodySuffix: for details on reporting intellectual property infringements.
trust.section4Body: Views and downloads of each resource are logged, and then every duplicate view, self-view (by the publisher themselves), view from an administrative account for review purposes, or view generated by automated software (bots) is excluded from the displayed statistics and financial calculations — so that the final numbers reflect a genuine audience as far as the current detection mechanisms allow.
trust.section5Body: Publishers' referral links are used only to record the source of a visit, and have no bearing on earnings calculations or revenue ownership at any stage. Revenue ownership is determined solely by who originally uploaded the resource.
trust.section6Body: Publisher earnings are calculated based on each publisher's share of eligible views out of the total eligible views during a given revenue period, whose total revenue figure is entered by the administration team. Earnings go through review and approval stages before being transferred to the publisher's verified payout account.
trust.section7Body: Sensitive payout account data (such as a CCP number) is stored fully encrypted, and can only be accessed through a very restricted administrative permission, with every such access recorded in an internal audit log.
trust.section8BodyPrefix: Globanic is a platform in continuous growth. We do not make claims of formal accreditation, institutional recognition, or a specific legal compliance commitment that has not actually been confirmed. For more, see the
